edits.prompt: Create a precise facial animation source sheet for an ORIGINAL visual-novel character. The input image is the approved face crop and is the only identity/style reference. Keep its exact face shape, head tilt, camera, lighting, nose, skin colours, hair, and every non-target feature. It uses simple clean anime linework and hard cel shadows; do not add detail or painterly rendering. Every grid cell must show the SAME COMPLETE input face crop with IDENTICAL scale, framing, and placement; change ONLY the specified feature. Each cell fills its rectangle edge to edge with no gutters, margins, borders, printed labels, numbers, diagrams, watermarks, or extra art. Keep all cells equal in size so a deterministic packer can extract their features. Preserve transparent areas from the input. Output a 4-column by 2-row grid, eight cells, on a 2048x1024 image. Reading left-to-right, top row: 1 A, lips sealed for M/B/P; 2 B, slight horizontal opening with a thin strip of upper teeth; 3 C, medium relaxed open mouth for EH/AE with a dark cavity and modest teeth; 4 D, a wider and taller open AH mouth, dark cavity, upper teeth, subtle tongue. Bottom row: 5 E, rounded open OH mouth; 6 F, small pursed OO mouth; 7 REPAIR, completely remove the entire mouth and all lip lines, mouth corners, lip highlights and lower-lip shadows, healing that local area into perfectly continuous matching unmarked facial skin; 8 X, the unchanged approved resting mouth. Mouth expressions remain relaxed and subtle, never exaggerated or screaming. IMPORTANT: all mouths stay centered at the original resting mouth position; preserve its small diagonal angle if present. Nothing outside the lip/chin region changes. In the REPAIR cell the face is still complete with its original eyes and nose; only the mouth is absent. No letters or text in the actual image.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: mouth articulation source atlas. Reference image 1 is an EXACT tight lower-face crop from an approved original anime character, showing only the nose, cheeks and resting mouth. Do not extend this crop to show eyes, hair or the whole head.
Create a precise 3 by 3 grid of NINE EQUAL SQUARE CELLS on a square 1536x1536 canvas. Each cell must reproduce the ENTIRE reference square, at EXACTLY the same scale and placement; NO zoom, NO pan, NO head movement, NO crop variation. The small nose and surrounding unedited cheek skin must stay absolutely IDENTICAL in every cell. Think of stamping the identical reference crop into every equal cell and editing only the mouth. There must be no gaps, borders, text or labels. Each cell is exactly one ninth of the image; never crop the last column.
Order left-to-right then top-to-bottom:
Row 1: lips sealed for M/B/P; a slight horizontal mouth opening with a thin strip of upper teeth; medium open relaxed EH/AE with upper teeth and a dark cavity.
Row 2: taller open AH mouth with dark cavity, upper teeth and subtle tongue; rounded open OH; small pursed OO.
Row 3: remove the ENTIRE mouth, lip corners, lip highlights and lower-lip shadow and heal ONLY that area into perfectly matching blank skin; the exact unchanged original resting mouth; duplicate of the exact unchanged original resting mouth.
All six articulated mouth shapes must remain in the SAME anatomical mouth location with a consistent corner-to-corner axis, preserving the original gentle diagonal smile angle. Wide shapes stay within the original resting mouth width; rounded shapes narrow around that same center. Mouth opening extends mostly downward. Expressions stay subtle rather than screaming. Do not slide a mouth sideways or down the face between cells.
Use the reference's SIMPLE anime linework and hard cel shading, flat colours; no painted textures, glossy extra lip detail, blush, gradients, realistic skin, new face markings or captions. No irises or eyes need to be invented because the reference is a lower-face crop. Keep all skin, nose and any visible contour pixels outside the mouth unchanged. This is a new targeted mouth-sheet replacement; it is not permission to redesign the character.
